about: The lane registry (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-e2e-reliability-design.md, lanes table). A suite with no lane is backbone: red or green, a PR's red when its diff reaches it. A lane entry is tolerant (its result depends on an AI answer, the clock or the outside world, named in `input`), suspended (flips red then green on one commit; shown, never blocks) or retired; every lane entry names when it returns or retires in `returns`. tools/pr-verdict.py shows a red tolerant or suspended suite grey on a PR; it reads this file from the PR's BASE branch, so a PR that edits it is judged by main's copy and its entry counts after it merges. Moving a suite out of the backbone is an expectation change (spec rule E): the PR names the input and why. First cut 28 Oct 2026, from the week's reds (tools/e2e_weekly.py). Backbone entries may carry aiMissesMax, the committed non-negative integer ceiling for asks without a stored answer; without it a suite is not checked.

qualityai.why: A live Jobs check on the golden postings measures the model's facts, scores and judge texts as rates.
qualityai.returns: Stays tolerant: it measures the live model.

mailreading.why: The live mail-reading eval now runs as a watched part of qualityai, keeping one tolerant AI suite.
mailreading.returns: Retired permanently; use qualityai:mail for a manual mail-reading eval.

notion-real.why: The one suite on a real Notion workspace (nightly and before beta; never PR/push reach): what the in-memory stand-in cannot prove depends on Notion's own pages and rate limits, which are not ours.
notion-real.returns: Stays tolerant: it tests Notion itself.
